description: `WithProjectDefaults` no longer overwrites an explicit Kestrel certificate configuration (`Kestrel__Certificates__Default__Path`, `KeyPath`, or `Subject`) set via `WithHttpsCertificateConfiguration`. Previously the built-in PFX default replaced the certificate path while leaving a stale key path, producing a mixed PFX/PEM configuration that Kestrel rejected with "The provided key file is missing or invalid."
name: Preserve explicit Kestrel certificate configuration
